name: agy-cli-prompt-enhancer
description: Token-efficient Prompt Enhancer toolkit for Antigravity CLI (PreInvocation plugin, Go ConPTY wrapper, fail-closed hook spec, and core engine).

scripts.check: node --check plugin/hook.mjs && node --check specs/fail-closed-hook/hook.mjs && node --check legacy-daemon/enhance.mjs && node --check wrapper/linux/enhance.mjs && node --check scripts/package-plugin.mjs && node --check scripts/release.mjs && node --check scripts/auto-bump-on-commit.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:hook && npm run test:engine && npm run verify:contracts
scripts.build: npm run verify && npm run package
